question.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: Chlorine can easily combine with oxygen to from oxides: and the product has a tendency to explode.

Statement II: Chemical reactivity of an element can be determined by its reaction with oxygen and halogens.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: Both the statements I and II are true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both the Statements I and II are false

solution.text:
Chlorine oxides, Cl2O, ClO2, Cl2O6 and Cl2O7 are highly reactive oxidising agents and tend to explode.

Chemical reactivity of an element can be determined by its reaction with oxygen and halogens.
